music.modifications: Generated with Google Lyria 3 Pro (lyria-3-pro-preview) from an original timeline prompt; edited by tools/production/sleepy-hollow-20261013/music_build.py (cut into 7 segments on the S109 timeline: title hit, folk waltz, heartbeat pulse, 6/8 chase that stops dead on the pumpkin, music-box morning, waltz reprise, final chord; NumPy-synthesized wind, fire, thunder, cannon, flame whoosh, pumpkin crash and bells; no third-party samples), then trimmed to the film body and encoded to 48 kbps MP3, 48 kHz stereo (library size budget). Timed to sample S109; other films will not hit its accents.

note: 英文旁白为预先生成的 Gemini 2.5 Pro TTS 云端配音（音色 Charon，随包旁白种子，播放不联网）；改旁白文字后新句需要本机配音整片重配。底图（AI 生成）以 1600 宽 WebP data URI 内联在幕代码里，共用底图的幕共用一个模块（open/hook、chase/throw）；剪影是矢量路径。配乐 Sleepy Hollow（CC0，随包曲库 library:original-sleepy-hollow）按本片逐字时间轴剪辑：改节奏或换曲后重击与骤停不再对齐。夜色参数在 credit 幕的 nights，追逐越切越快在 chase 幕的 cutFactor。画面文字用系统衬线字体（macOS 为 Baskerville），其他系统回退 Georgia。南瓜爆裂有一下接近全白的闪光。正文约 128 秒，导出时接约 4.9 秒品牌片尾
